description: Drive the BMAD build lane for one story end-to-end: branch, bmad-build-auto plan -> (opt-in spec approval) -> build, risk-gated TEA, a follow-up review pass on a second model, epic-boundary gates + retrospective, a commit per step, PR, and report. Delegates every step to a model-tuned subagent.
outputs: Story branch + per-step commits; optional PR; appended run report under {output_folder}/auto-bmad/reports/

description: Drive a WHOLE epic end-to-end in one run: one epic branch, the bmad-build-auto plan -> build -> follow-up review loop per story (no per-story halts), epic-end gates + retrospective (verdict recorded), one PR. Warns and confirms up front; completes a half-done epic.
outputs: One epic/{e}-slug branch + per-story commits; one PR; epic report under {output_folder}/auto-bmad/reports/epic-{e}.md

description: Register the module, write auto-bmad's runtime config (first-run interview) and sync its review layers into _bmad/custom/bmad-build-auto.toml. reprovision re-syncs those layers after editing config; reset-defaults discards profile retunes in config.yaml and re-seeds the shipped defaults; config-check previews (read-only) what an update would add and what you've customised vs the defaults.
outputs: Registered abm in the help CSV; {output_folder}/auto-bmad/config.yaml; managed review layers in _bmad/custom/bmad-build-auto.toml (reset-defaults saves the prior config to config.yaml.bak)
